Product Description

The 15-piece knife block set features all the tools you need to start your kitchen out right. This block set includes the all-rounder 8-inch chef’s knife, which is perfect for chopping herbs and dicing onions, and 5-inch serrated utility knife, ideal for cutting soft interior, hard exterior foods. Efficiently mince garlic with the hollow edge santoku, featuring a blade that has small indentations, known as grantons, that prevent food from sticking while cutting. Housed in a handsome hardwood block, this set is complete with kitchen shears, a sharpening steel, and six 4.5-inch steak knives. Fabricated from durable, high-quality stainless steel, Statement's single-piece, stamped blade construction is lighter than forged knives. Along with the full tang, this encourages maximum maneuverability. The traditional triple-rivet handles are curved for comfort and balance while the stainless-steel endcap adds aesthetic appeal. Set includes 3-inch paring, 5-inch serrated utility, 5-inch hollow edge santoku, 7-inch hollow edge santoku, 8-inch chef's knife, 8-inch bread knife, 6 x 4.5-inch steak knives, sharpening steel, kitchen shears, and hardwood block.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Sharp, beautiful, and sturdy knife set!
    Reviewed in the United States on June 28, 2026

    I have wanted these Henckels knives for a long time and finally got the opportunity during a Prime Day sale.

    I can't say enough good things about these knives. They are sharp so be careful! Compared to the dull knives I used before, there is no comparison. These knives easily slice through everything I use them for, mostly meat and veggies. This set contains every type of knife I need, including scissors and a sharpener.

    I will not allow these beautiful knives to sit in soapy water or the dishwasher, therefore I can't speak to how well they will hold up over time to rusting. I am relying exclusively on the well-regarded reputation of the manufacturer.

    Overall, I gave these knives 5-stars because of the quality, sharpness, and ease of handling. They are sturdy and I am not concerned about rusting or degrading of the metal. This is an excellent set for the price and I'm very pleased!

    bought these knives to prep dinner. I wasn’t expecting to enter a committed relationship.

    The first time I used the chef’s knife, it slid through a tomato so effortlessly that I had to look around to make sure nobody saw me smiling. The sharpness is downright scandalous. Carrots? Paper-thin. Steak? Like butter. My old knives watched from the drawer in shame.

    The balance is incredible, the grip feels just right in your hand, and every slice is so smooth it should probably come with a warning label. Cooking has become dangerously enjoyable. I now volunteer to chop everything. “Need onions diced?” Say less.

    My spouse is starting to get jealous because I’ve been spending an awful lot of quality time with this knife block. Honestly, I haven’t felt this much excitement in the kitchen in years.

    If you’ve never whispered, “Oh… wow,” after slicing a bell pepper, you’re about to.

    Five stars. Sharp enough to cut vegetables… and dangerously close to stealing my heart. ❤️🔪

    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The steel is arguably soft, but that is typical of european (particularly german) blades. The iron content of this stainless steel is high and the nickel content may be low. If left wet for long, it may develop rust spots. However, you should always clean and dry a knife after using it anyway. If taken care of, these blades will last many years. They will cut what you want and retain a nice shape.

    The chef's knife is great. It is the primary knife used in my kitchen. It is comfortable to use, slices through most anything with relative ease. After about ten to fifteen diced onions I like to hone the blade again to keep work quick and easy. A dull knife is much more dangerous than a sharp one they say. Despite frequent maintenance, it does an excellent job and doesn't fatigue me.

    The santokus are of decent quality, and feel excellent for everyday tasks. The larger one has a good weight and feeling allowing for prolonged veggie extermination, and the smaller one is light and maneuverable to really slice and shape whatever you need.

    The paring knife is a razor blade with a handle basically. If the chef knife is too big or unwieldy for a task, the lil guy will step up with no issue.

    The bread knife is sharp. It WILL cut bread. Cake too, I bet.

    There is another smaller serrated knife but I have yet to use it.

    The scissors are nothing special but provide you something to open any package of food.

    The steak knives are beautiful but have lesser quality steel than the bigger knives. These will straight up form rust spots if left in the sink overnight, esp along the handle and spine of the blade. Just clean them after use and they should stay pretty and sharp for ya.

    The included file is useful to keep my blades honed.

    I'd say this set is a pretty solid value for your money if you are looking for a good set of knives for the kitchen. If you don't sharpen your knives or prefer a cheap kitchenaid knife, this isn't for you. For the home cook who uses their knives for everything and appreciates them, I recommend them.

About this Item

  • ULTRA-SHARP BLADES: Superior professional-level sharpness that ensures precision cutting.
  • THE LAST KNIFE YOU’LL EVER NEED TO BUY: German Engineered Knife Informed by over 100 Years of Mastery. HENCKELS knives are built to last.
  • EFFORTLESS CUTTING: Enjoy easy cutting with minimal effort with this lightweight, easy-to-use knife.
  • SET INCLUDES: 3-inch paring knife, 5-inch serrated utility knife, 7-inch santoku knife hollow edge, 8-inch chef's knife, 8-inch bread knife, 4.5-inch steak knife set of 6, professional honing steel, kitchen shears, and hardwood knife block
  • QUICK CLEAN UP: No-fuss cleanup, in the dishwasher or by hand. Stain and rust-free blades.
  • WORTH THE SPLURGE: HENCKELS knives start out razor-sharp and stay sharper longer, even with minimal care.
  • DURABLE BLADE: Single-piece, precision-stamped blade construction provides durability.

Product Description

The 15-piece knife block set features all the tools you need to start your kitchen out right. This block set includes the all-rounder 8-inch chef’s knife, which is perfect for chopping herbs and dicing onions, and 5-inch serrated utility knife, ideal for cutting soft interior, hard exterior foods. Efficiently mince garlic with the hollow edge santoku, featuring a blade that has small indentations, known as grantons, that prevent food from sticking while cutting. Housed in a handsome hardwood block, this set is complete with kitchen shears, a sharpening steel, and six 4.5-inch steak knives. Fabricated from durable, high-quality stainless steel, Statement's single-piece, stamped blade construction is lighter than forged knives. Along with the full tang, this encourages maximum maneuverability. The traditional triple-rivet handles are curved for comfort and balance while the stainless-steel endcap adds aesthetic appeal. Set includes 3-inch paring, 5-inch serrated utility, 5-inch hollow edge santoku, 7-inch hollow edge santoku, 8-inch chef's knife, 8-inch bread knife, 6 x 4.5-inch steak knives, sharpening steel, kitchen shears, and hardwood block.
